title: Backporting some of the armors I like from Skyrim and Oblivion into Morrowind with Astra. Its skilled enough at blender to split off pauldrons and greaves from the Skyrim armors, and to refit armor pieces to Morrowind proportions.
author: Original-League-6094

comments.author: seahorse-emoji
comments.body: Oh nice ! is this a mod that you are making ?

replies.author: Original-League-6094
replies.body:
I wouldn't be allowed to redistribute it, since Bethesda has a history of taking down mods that use assets from one of their games in another, and I am ripping the Skyrim assets here.

But yes, its a personal mod. Anyone can do it with Astra. The armor takes multiple iterations of fit checks, but it will one shot weapons. Here is the Oblivion Daedric long sword.

https://preview.redd.it/fmobw1gc7eoh1.png?width=2560&format=png&auto=webp&s=5f65cdcf5b1f6110202c4886a83750fe38fc6c42

replies.author: -NH2AMINE
replies.body: If you are recreating them then i think it would be fair but if you are actually using the exact asset file from skyrim then yeah they would take it down

comments.author: obamidala
comments.body: I can’t wait to see the complex LUA mods Astra makes for Morrowind

comments.author: Cool_Quail_2924
comments.body: The fact that it can refit proportions between game engines is wild. That used to be like three hours of manual vertex pushing per piece.
